'''R2-M5''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid]] with [[Color|red]], white, and silver plating and a black [[sensor]]. Like all [[R-series|R2]] [[astromech droid]]s, R2-M5 was manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]] and stood ninety-six [[centimeter]]s tall.<ref name="AEYNTK" /> The [[droid]] served [[Royal Naboo Security Forces|Royal Security Forces]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] during the reign of [[Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]. After the [[Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo|invaded]] Naboo and captured its [[capital]] [[Theed]], R2-M5 was in the [[Theed Hangar]] under guard by [[B1-series battle droid]]s when Amidala and her allies [[Battle of Naboo|attacked]] the [[battle droid]]s in order to retake the hangar. Amidala's forces successfully managed to destroy the Trade Federation droids, allowing the [[pilot]]s of [[Bravo Squadron]] and their astromechs to board their [[N-1 starfighter]] and launch for battle against the Trade Federation forces [[Blockade|blockading]] their planet. The Trade Federation were ultimately defeated and driven off Naboo.<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
R2-M5 first appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> The droid was first identified in [[canon]] in the [[2015]] [[Wikipedia:Gashapon|gacha]] toy ''[[Star Wars Pullback Droid]]'', which was released by [[Tomy|T-ARTS Company,Ltd.]].<ref name="Pullback Droid">''[[Star Wars Pullback Droid]]''</ref> The name was originally revealed in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] in the "Astromech Droid Pack Series 2" set of figures released by [[Hasbro]] in [[2006]].<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Saga Collection|pack=Astromech Droid Pack (Series 2)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TSCastroS2.asp}}</ref>
